title: Demon Couple in Lava Realm
description: A green-skinned female demon with black hair kneels on cobblestone holding a large ornate hammer, wearing a yellow ruffled top and denim shorts. Behind her stands a taller male demon with horns and a fur-collared coat, both positioned in a stone archway with lava flows, overlooking a volcanic landscape with a dark castle at sunset.
prompt: A green-skinned female demon with short black hair and yellow eyes kneels on cobblestone ground holding a large decorated hammer with both hands, wearing a yellow ruffled crop top and denim shorts with yellow bows. Behind her stands a tall male demon with curved horns, wearing a long brown coat with black fur collar over a red vest. They are framed by a black and white stone archway with dripping lava, overlooking a volcanic landscape with a dark gothic castle on a mountain under an orange sunset sky.
